Landing.feature1Body: A parametric workflow engine models your process, not the other way around.
Landing.feature2Body: Every action is role-gated from the start, with no bolt-on access control.
Landing.feature3Body: Every change is traceable, so you always know who did what and when.
Landing.footerLicense: Open source core. Commercial use requires a license.
